name: Slant Divider
tag: Sections cut on a diagonal using clip-path, scaling with the viewport.
html:
Overview

A clean start

The first section sits flat on the page, with plenty of calm around the text.

In the middle

Cut on the diagonal

The band is clipped top and bottom with the same angle, so it reads as a single slanted stripe.

Wrap-up

Back to level ground

The next section tucks neatly behind the stripe, with no gaps or seams.
